onb.title: Set up HyperShutter
onb.welcome_title: Your wedding footage, ingested, sorted and organized
onb.welcome: HyperShutter copies your cards to several drives with checksum verification, makes proxies, and sorts every clip by moment of the day. You review the sorting before any file moves. Choose your language.
onb.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is missing. Install it with Homebrew in Terminal, then open HyperShutter again:
onb.key: The sorting uses Claude to look at your clips. Paste your API key: it goes straight to the macOS Keychain and never into a file. You can skip this and sort offline (time gaps and sound only).
onb.dest: Where cards are copied to. Choose two drives for a safe ingest; you can change them for every card.
ingest.title: Offload cards
ingest.sub: Read once, written to every drive at the same time, verified by xxHash64. The card is only read.

ingest.label: Source label
ingest.label_hint: The folder for this camera in the event, e.g. cam apos, cam dim, drone, sound. Remembered for this camera.
ingest.project_hint: The same name is used on every destination drive.
ingest.rules: Nothing is overwritten and the card is never written to. Each file is verified on every drive; only then is the card safe to format (HyperShutter never formats it).
ingest.safe: Safe to format: every file is verified on every drive
ingest.not_safe: Not safe to format: keep the card and check the files below
ingest.summary: {files} files, {gb} GB · {copied} copied, {skipped} already there · {s} s
export.sub: One file per clip, same length, in folders that mirror the categories. No cutting, no editing.
export.folders_hint: Nothing ticked exports the whole event.

drives.sub: Free space on every connected drive, the events on them and the space left after the queued work.
drives.hint: Warning levels are in Settings. Ingest and export check the space before they start.
lab.title: Evaluation
lab.sub: Sorts an event you already organized, read-only and with the names hidden from the model, and compares the result with your folders.
lab.run_hint: Uses the open event's folders as the answer. Nothing moves; the report is saved with the others below.
lab.confirm: This runs the full sorting on the open event and uses the API (the cost estimate is in Scan & Analyze). Continue?

feat.title: From the card to organized folders
feat.sub: Built for wedding videographers; baptisms and other events work through presets.
feat.ingest_text: Copies a card to several drives at once, reading it only once. Every copy is read back and checked by xxHash64, with an ASC MHL and a report on each drive.
feat.proxies_text: ProRes Proxy or H.264 proxies start as soon as a clip is verified, at background priority, where Premiere's Attach Proxies finds them.
feat.sort_text: Groups clips by moment of the wedding from capture time, the picture, the sound and the camera, and builds this event's own folders.
feat.review_text: You check and correct everything — rename, merge, split, reorder, move clips — before a single file moves.
feat.organize_text: Numbered Greeklish folders on every drive copy, sidecars and proxies included, a shot index and contact sheets, and a journal that undoes it all.
feat.drives_text: Free space on every drive, what each event takes, the space left after queued work, and warnings before you run out.
feat.export_text: Review copies, archives or edit-friendly intermediates for whole categories, with editable presets and a pausable queue.
feat.lab_text: Measures the sorting against events you already organized, so you know how far to trust it.
help.title: Help
help.q1: Is it safe to format a card after an ingest?
help.a1: Only when HyperShutter says “Safe to format”: every file has been read back from every drive and its checksum matches the card. HyperShutter never formats a card itself.
help.q2: Does HyperShutter change my original files?
help.a2: No. Files are only copied (ingest) or moved inside the same drive (organize), never re-encoded, never deleted and never overwritten. Every move is in a journal and can be undone.
help.q3: What is sent to the AI model?
help.a3: Contact sheets of frames, capture times, durations, the camera, and short sound categories (e.g. “chanting 80%, applause”). Never file names, folder paths, your speech or your API key.
help.q4: Can I use it without internet?
help.a4: Yes: ingest, proxies, export and the offline sorting (time gaps and sound) work without the API. The AI sorting needs internet and an API key.
help.q5: How do I undo an organize?
help.a5: In Review, Apply → Undo. Every file goes back to its exact original path and name on every drive copy.
help.q6: Where are my settings and caches?
help.a6: In ~/Library/Application Support/HyperShutter. Event folders only get the organized files, the shot index, the contact sheets and a small .hypershutter folder.
help.diag_hint: Diagnostics contain settings, versions and logs only — never footage, frames or the API key.
